title: The Cinderhall 'hall's claim' political thread (started via 'back the hall's claim (Free Companies)' / '(the Watch)' with Ness at the head-frame) never surfaced its own resolution scene in Cinderhall itself — I only learned it had concluded from an offhand line at Wardmoor's Captain-General's Hall ('A Watch clerk sits at Cinderhall's chapterhouse desk now, backing the miners' hall'), so a player who never travels to Wardmoor would never see this thread pay off.
where: The Head-Frame (Cinderhall) quest hook / payoff only visible at The Captain-General's Hall (Wardmoor)
